scope: Independent source, bilingual, orthographic conversion, contextual cue, and compact runtime projection review. This is automated review, not professional human validation, tokenizer admission, execution authorization, or evidence of improved translation.

source_verification.method: Independently reopened the same two named official current-page rendered-text responses and checked all eight complete aligned pairs, source contexts, displayed revision labels, and license footers against the local excerpts.
source_verification.limitations: Responses may be cached. Displayed revision IDs are observed metadata, not proof of independently retrieved immutable revision bytes. Local hashes identify captured excerpts. No guarantee about unread notices is asserted.

method_constraints: Exact-anchor overlap and local bank uniqueness are not semantic disambiguation guarantees.
Select the unique full-anchor record, then scan only that record's designated focus outside its anchor; substring matching includes occurrences within other words and overlapping occurrences.

Final token wording must use B and C for complete baseline/candidate chat templates including generation markers, delta=C-B, delta<=min(16,floor(0.40*B)), and C<=384; standalone prefix tokenization is not the gate.
Over-budget rows return the unchanged baseline; unchanged global coverage failure stops the attempt. Do not prune, replace or rewrite the frozen bank after preflight.
No new fixtures, private criteria, prior ratings or held-out outputs were inspected; no tokenizer or model calls, installation, training, or publication occurred in this review.
